MasteryTier.description:
The four-state deterministic mastery ladder (knowledge-map, KT-A).

Computed by the ``narrative/`` map-state kernel (KT-B) from stored records;
an LLM never assigns, names, or explains a tier. ``target_tier`` on a
``MasterySetPoint`` (knowledge-map-overlay spec) is a member of this enum.
MasteryTier.title: MasteryTier

description:
The explicit per-node user control - the only record that can lower
mastery. Applies to any node; on a custom node it caps at ``honed`` (a
store/kernel concern, KT-B - the contract accepts any ``MasteryTier``).
title: MasterySetPoint
